title: Every bus in Oshawa in 24 hours
description:
Every bus running in Oshawa on an average October weekday, from the morning rush to the next morning, in 50 seconds.

I took the October 2026 timetables, kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays, and put each vehicle where its schedule says it is. The count is the average for that minute and only includes vehicles inside the Oshawa city limits. The faded ones are just outside. Colours: Local and PULSE, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 50 buses at 4:20 pm.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Thanksgiving (October 12).
